mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_name, d.building, d.budget, COUNT(DISTINCT i.ID) AS teacher_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) AS course_count FROM department d LEFT JOIN instructor i ON i.dept_name = d.dept_name LEFT JOIN course c ON c.dept_name = d.dept_name GROUP BY d.dept_name, d.building, d.budget ORDER BY d.dept_name

SELECT d.dept_name, d.building, d.budget, COUNT(DISTINCT i.ID) AS teacher_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) AS course_count FROM department d LEFT JOIN instructor i ON i.dept_name = d.dept_name LEFT JOIN course c ON c.dept_name = d.dept_name GROUP BY d.dept_name, d.building, d.budget ORDER BY d.dept_name LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT dept_name, building, budget FROM department ORDER BY dept_name
SELECT ID AS id, name, dept_name, salary FROM instructor WHERE dept_name = #{deptName} ORDER BY ID
SELECT course_id, title, dept_name, credits FROM course WHERE dept_name = #{deptName} ORDER BY course_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES (#{deptName}, #{building}, #{budget})
